clusters.label: Unauthorized Charges & Missing Orders
clusters.summary: Covers 16 distinct feedback texts (~1,369 reports, 19.6% of volume) around unauthorized charges & missing orders. Dominant category: Fraud and Scam.
clusters.recommendation: Freeze captures on flagged charge patterns, auto-refund undelivered orders within 48 hours, and surface a one-tap dispute path at checkout.
clusters.why: This theme represents 1,369 reports (19.6% of all feedback) with 77% negative sentiment, growing 2.1x across the 12-week window — priority 100.0.

examples: I encountered a scam where the seller asked for additional payment after placing the order.
I was scammed by this seller. The product I received was not as advertised.
Unfortunately, the product did not meet my expectations. It stopped working after a week.
clusters.label: Seller & Listing Scams
clusters.summary: Covers 34 distinct feedback texts (~921 reports, 13.2% of volume) around seller & listing scams. Dominant category: Fraud and Scam.
clusters.recommendation: Suspend sellers after two verified scam reports, require listing-accuracy audits, and back every purchase with a no-questions buyer guarantee.
clusters.why: This theme represents 921 reports (13.2% of all feedback) with 68% negative sentiment, growing 1.5x across the 12-week window — priority 85.8.

clusters.label: Delivery Delays
clusters.summary: Covers 19 distinct feedback texts (~732 reports, 10.5% of volume) around delivery delays. Dominant category: Operational Issues.
clusters.recommendation: Set carrier SLAs for the worst-performing lanes, send proactive delay notifications with tracking, and pre-authorize compensation for late orders.
clusters.why: This theme represents 732 reports (10.5% of all feedback) with 85% negative sentiment, growing 1.6x across the 12-week window — priority 70.3.

clusters.label: Damaged & Wrong Orders
clusters.summary: Covers 19 distinct feedback texts (~846 reports, 12.1% of volume) around damaged & wrong orders. Dominant category: Product Feedback.
clusters.recommendation: Add photo verification at the packing step and auto-ship replacements for every damaged or wrong-item report without a second contact.
clusters.why: This theme represents 846 reports (12.1% of all feedback) with 68% negative sentiment, growing 1.3x across the 12-week window — priority 63.6.

clusters.recommendation: Keep the fast-resolution scripts that earn praise, and escalate any ticket unresolved after first contact to a senior agent within two hours.
clusters.why: This theme represents 906 reports (12.9% of all feedback) with 65% negative sentiment, growing 1.0x across the 12-week window — priority 61.4.
